title: Jubilant Peppery Turkish Scallions Menemen
description: A peppery and pillowy Turkish dish featuring scallions, this menemen is a flexitarian-friendly adventure for the taste buds, with a surprising twist of candy added to balance the heat.

ingredients.name: candy pieces
ingredients.notes: such as M&M's or chopped peanut butter cups

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped scallions and cook until they are softened and lightly browned.
Add the turkish pepper, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Push the scallion mixture to one side of the skillet.
Crack the eggs into the other side of the skillet and scramble them until they are cooked through.
Mix the eggs and scallion mixture together.
Stir in the crumbled feta cheese and candy pieces.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the candy is heated through.
Serve the menemen hot, garnished with additional chopped scallions if desired.
